The '''Mandalorian super commandos''', or '''''Kyr'tsad Ori'ramikade''''' in [[Mando'a/Legends|Mando'a]], were a group of [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="SWE" /> [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] loyal to [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul's]] [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. They were formed after Maul [[Takeover of Mandalore/Legends|took over]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] and [[Death/Legends|killed]] the Death Watch's leader, [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]], usurping his command.

==History==
Following [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul's]] [[Takeover of Mandalore/Legends|takeover]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] super [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] were [[Battle of Mandalore/Legends|opposed]] by [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla's]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]], [[Bo-Katan Kryze/Legends|Bo-Katan Kryze]], and her rebel Death Watch [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]]. Kryze and her loyalists tried to honor Vizsla by disputing an outsider's rule of Mandalore, resisting Maul's control. The super commandos guarded the [[Sundari Royal Palace/Legends|Sundari Royal Palace]] under Maul's reign, they were used as both guards and soldiers, who tried to track down the escaping [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] and her companions.

Later on, they also pursued [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] when he rescued the [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]], and later the [[Nite Owls/Legends|Nite Owls]], who helped Kenobi to escape from Mandalore, after being imprisoned by Maul. In the meantime, at least four super commandos who guarded the Sundari Royal Palace were [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Choke|choked to death]] when [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] arrived on Mandalore to combat Maul and his brother, [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]], who raised his attention with their actions.<ref name="The Lawless">{{TCW|The Lawless}}</ref>

==Equipment==
The super commandos utilized the same type of armor as the rest of the Mandalorians. However, their armor was primarily [[Color/Legends|colored]] red, and at least [[Unidentified Mandalorian super commando captain/Legends|one commando]] had a helmet modified to incorporate horn-like growths in honor of Maul and Opress. A large number of them had clawed handprints over their helmets, similar to the handprint of [[Rishi eel/Legends|Rishi eel]] [[Blood/Legends|blood]] on clone trooper [[Echo/Legends|Echo's]] chestplate.
